name: Prefrontal Synaptic Density Increase
description: Increases synaptic density in the prefrontal cortex by 30–50%, enhancing executive function, working memory, abstract reasoning, and multi-variable problem solving. The modification doesn't make the user smarter in the IQ-test sense — it makes their thinking faster, more parallel, and more capable of holding complex systems in working memory. A Brainweave user can track more variables in a negotiation, see more moves ahead in strategic planning, and maintain more simultaneous trains of thought. The modification is the cognitive equivalent of upgrading from a dual-core to an eight-core processor. Zheng-Dao Bioelectric's version is the gold standard, developed originally for their own strategic planning division before being commercialized. The modification is widespread among corporate management, legal professionals, and anyone whose job requires complex decision-making under pressure.
source_organism: Synthetic neural growth factors (no single organism source), corvid synaptic density genes (Corvus corax, common raven)
procedure: Cranial retroviral injection with synaptic growth factor, 6 sessions over 3 months under neurological monitoring
reversibility: Irreversible — new synaptic connections are permanent
side_effects: Increased caloric demand from neural activity (brain consumes 30–40% more glucose)
Difficulty 'turning off' — racing thoughts, inability to relax
Heightened anxiety from seeing too many possible outcomes simultaneously
Headaches during development as new synaptic connections form
Rare: seizure activity from synaptic overconnectivity
social_perception: The corporate world's dirty secret. Officially, hiring based on cognitive modification status is illegal. Practically, unmodified candidates cannot compete with Brainweave users in high-level positions. The modification is creating a cognitive aristocracy.
story_hooks: A Brainweave user begins experiencing someone else's thoughts — their synaptic density increase has created a resonance with another modified brain in close proximity
A corporate whistleblower's Cortex Mod allows them to see the full scope of their company's corruption, including the connections that an unmodified mind would never have assembled
